text: A shirtless male figure with light skin stands in profile, facing right. He has short, blonde hair, a narrow face, and visible neck. Wearing dark shorts with a brown belt featuring a gold buckle, red arm bands, and a necklace with a circular pendant. A sword hangs at his waist. His posture is upright but slightly hunched forward. Behind him looms a large, shadowy figure in blue robes. Distant ruins and water are visible under a pinkish-purple sky.
